description: A smooth metal plate, usually covered with paper, interleaved between groups of sections during pressing to give a flat surface and to shield delicate plates or maps from indenting their neighbours.
name: pressing tin

source_ref.label: Douglas Cockerell, Bookbinding and the Care of Books (1902), Chapter V, p.89. Internet Archive.
